## Roma — the Ponyville tomato seller

Roma is the **cream-yellow Earth-pony market mare** who argues over the price of Fluttershy’s tomatoes in *Putting Your Hoof Down*. Pinkie Pie out-haggles her by repeatedly switching between “one bit” and “two bits.” She has a **two-tone brown mane and tail, turquoise eyes, three red tomatoes as her cutie mark**, and is often shown wearing a white vendor’s cap and teal apron. [Character and naming reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Roma).

[![Roma — recognizable market-pony vector](https://www.pinclipart.com/picdir/big/95-950683_graphic-freeuse-stock-apron-vector-printing-my-little.png)](https://www.pinclipart.com/maxpin/Thhwxh/)

*Image: redistributed vector of the character on PinClipart; the original illustrator is not identified on the verified hosting page. The character’s television design belongs to Hasbro’s* Friendship Is Magic *production.*

- **Name:** “Roma” is a **fandom/encyclopedia placeholder**, suggestive of Roma tomatoes—not a name spoken in the show. Twibooru also lists “Roma tomato” as a tag alias. The *Elements of Harmony* guidebook calls her **“MARKET SALESPONY”**; the *One Bad Apple* credits call her **“Vendor.”**
- **Speaking:** **Yes.** In [*Putting Your Hoof Down* (S2E19)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Putting_Your_Hoof_Down), she disputes the price with Fluttershy and Pinkie. In [*One Bad Apple* (S3E4)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/One_Bad_Apple), she calls out her carrot-crêpe sales. **Shannon Chan-Kent** is listed as her English voice for **S3E4**; the performer for the S2E19 lines is not established by the sources checked. [Voice cast reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Shannon_Chan-Kent).
- **Other appearances:** A stallholder at the Rainbow Falls Traders Exchange in *Trade Ya!* (S4E22), sometimes without her cap; later selling hot cocoa at the Rainbow Falls Hearth’s Warming Craft Fair in *Best Gift Ever* (2018).

**Memory hook:** The **three-tomato cutie mark** and the vendor who falls for Pinkie’s **one-bit/two-bit** bargaining trick.
